column1: # devkit rule files: rules/-relative source <TAB> destination.
# install.sh symlinks each destination at its source, so a `git pull` in devkit updates
# every machine. $HOME expands. Lines whose destination PARENT directory is absent
# are skipped with a notice -- that is how the work laptop, which has no
# ~/code/personal tree, ends up with the global rules and nothing it cannot use.
